items.quote: is open to all eligible Suppliers as defined in the Regulations
Suppliers may submit quotations for one, several, or all items.
Award will be made separately for each item to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive Supplier
In case of any discrepancy between the Russian and English versions, the Russian version shall prevail.
The validity period of quotations shall be 45 days from the deadline for submission.
Quotations shall be submitted in sealed envelopes clearly marked “UZ-INSON-RFQ-3.2.3/R” and indicating the item number(s) quoted, to the address below.
Electronic submissions will not be accepted.
Late quotations will be rejected and returned unopened.
Deadline for submission of quotations is 23 October 2026 at 17:00 Tashkent time (UTC+5).
